ऋ॑घा—वत् and ऋ॑घा—वन्, mfn. raving, impetuous, violent, RV.;
 [cf. Zd. ěrěghant; Mod. Germ. arg.]

Nom. P. Ā. ऋघायति, -ते, to be passionate or impetuous, rave, rage, RV.;
to tremble, RV. ii, 25, 3; iv, 17, 2.
